blurb: Nestled among the rolling hills of the Willamette Valley, J Wrigley Vineyards provides sweeping views, peaceful moments, and wines inspired by the land they come from. Family-owned and welcoming, the vineyard encourages guests to relax, explore, and enjoy handcrafted wines in a tranquil setting.
